purpose: Reconciles the five deliverable scenarios against Petpooja's own Order List, because the save_order RESPONSE omits orderID even when the order registers. It establishes RECEIPT and total reconciliation independently of our runner; it does NOT establish fulfilment (that would require the vendor's terminal status/callback evidence).

method.oracle: Petpooja dashboard -> Order List, filtered to Restaurant name 5439 - Burgonomics DEMO [135148] - 31z58ciw0h
method.whyNotApi: Neither API host exposes an order-listing/fetch route - scripts/petpooja-route-matrix.mjs proved only save_order, update_order_status and mapped_restaurant_menus exist. The dashboard is therefore the only RECEIPT/listing oracle available here; fulfilment needs a terminal 10 Delivered state (callback or Order List detail), not a listing row.
method.pairingKey: clientOrderID (the value we send as orderinfo.Order.orderID) plus the order total
method.orderListOrderNoColumn: Petpooja displays OUR clientOrderID in its 'Order No.' column; no separate POS-issued id is exposed.
method.caveat: The evidence JSON scores these rows ok:false because its verdict required an orderID in the response body. That runner verdict has been corrected to RELAY ACCEPTANCE (scripts/petpooja-sandbox-5scenarios.mjs); the row-level totals and clientOrderIDs it recorded are unchanged and are what is reconciled here. Relay acceptance is not fulfilment.

scenarios.title: Item with Addon and Variation + Tax

verdict.result: 5/5 RECEIVED and total-reconciled; 0/5 fulfilment VERIFIED — the 2026-10-17 Order List snapshot records 'Waiting For Acceptance', and the later callback evidence is tracked in section 19.2 of references/petpooja_save_order_api.md

history.correction: This file previously asserted 'PASS — 5/5 FULFILLED' and marked every row fulfilled:true from the Order List listing alone. That conflated RECEIVED with fulfilment. The vendor's own word 'fulfilled' is not a documented state (its terminal state is 10 Delivered); case 2 was cancelled (-1) and case 3 reached Food Ready (5), so fulfilment remains 0/5 verified. Rows now carry received/fulfilmentVerified; the original listing status is preserved verbatim below.

supportingPointers.claim: The relay did place the orders despite the empty orderID
supportingPointers.evidence: All five clientOrderIDs appear in the Order List with exact total matches, 2-5 seconds after the runner finished (evidence file written 2026-10-16 22:10:26).

supportingPointers.claim: The scenario variants reached the POS, not just our payload builder
supportingPointers.evidence: The same Order List shows probe rows as Home Delivery (Delivery), Home Delivery (Self delivery), Parcel/Pickup, Table/Dine-in and one Advanced Order - the variants scripted in scripts/petpooja-orderid-sweep.mjs.

supportingPointers.claim: No order-listing API route exists, so the dashboard is the only oracle
supportingPointers.evidence: scripts/petpooja-route-matrix.json - only save_order, update_order_status and mapped_restaurant_menus answer on either host; update_order_status is undocumented and every other spelling 403s.
